It says right at the top they it’s AI. Is AI ENHANCING our human creativity or SUPPRESSING it as artists may begin to feel “Why bother?”

Absolutely. I believe AI should be a tool, not a replacement for human creativity. 🌿

For me, the intention, emotion, musical thought and storytelling still come first. AI simply helps bring some of those ideas to life in ways that may not otherwise be possible.

The real question isn't “Why bother?” — it's whether we can use technology without losing the human heart behind the art. ❤️🎶

Thank you so much for your beautiful words—they truly mean a lot to us. ❤️
The music is created through a combination of AI, human creativity, and artistic direction. Every piece is carefully composed, refined, and shaped to create a calming, immersive experience.
The flute you hear is the Indian bamboo flute, traditionally known as the Bansuri. While "flute" is the more commonly used Western term, the Bansuri is handcrafted from bamboo, which gives it its beautifully elongated, warm, and deeply expressive tone.
The singing sound you're hearing may also come from resonant Indian instruments and carefully layered ambient textures that blend together to create the atmosphere.
Thank you again for listening so deeply and for sharing how this music makes you feel. Wishing you many more peaceful moments. 🙏❤️
